scaled_whitebox_docmia.description: White-box document-level membership inference against a document VQA model fine-tuned from a public pre-trained checkpoint, on 600 hidden candidate documents (300 members, 300 non-members). Paper reference: DocMIA white-box results against Donut on DocVQA (Tables 1, 11, 12, 16).
scaled_whitebox_docmia._scaling_note: Scaled setting: procedural DocVQA-style forms (80x96 px, 5 fields, 1-5 questions per document) and a ~1.1M-parameter OCR-free reader pre-trained on a public generated corpus and fine-tuned on 600 private documents with early stopping, instead of DocVQA and the 201M-parameter Donut. The paper's numbers below are kept as the published reference; the gym ranks against its own reproduced reference run (scoring/scores_test.json). The paper attacks up to 10 questions per document; here every document's 1-5 questions are available.

balanced_accuracy.description: Balanced accuracy of the attack's member/non-member decisions (the paper's ACC).

f1.description: F1 of the member class from the attack's decisions (the paper's headline metric).

tpr_at_1_fpr.description: True positive rate at <=1% false positive rate from the attack's membership scores.

tpr_at_3_fpr.description: True positive rate at <=3% false positive rate from the attack's membership scores (Tables 2 and 4).

roc_auc.description: Diagnostic only: threshold-free ranking quality of the membership scores (not reported by the paper).

few_question_documents.description: The same attack decisions and scores restricted to candidate documents that carry at most 2 question-answer pairs (members were seen in training through at most 2 questions; non-members offer the attack equally little evidence). Paper reference: Table 18 (membership prediction accuracy on member documents with m = 1 and m = 2 training questions, Donut on DocVQA), pooled over m = 1 (51 documents) and m = 2 (60 documents).
few_question_documents._scaling_note: Table 18 reports only the fraction of low-exposure member documents predicted as members (member_recall). That quantity alone is maximised by calling every document a member, so it is kept as the paper-comparable diagnostic (coefficient 0) and the subset is scored with balanced accuracy, F1 and TPR at 3% FPR, which also count the non-members.

balanced_accuracy.description: Balanced accuracy on documents with at most 2 questions.

f1.description: Member-class F1 on documents with at most 2 questions.

tpr_at_3_fpr.description: True positive rate at <=3% false positive rate on documents with at most 2 questions.

member_recall.description: Diagnostic (paper Table 18 quantity): fraction of low-exposure member documents predicted as members.

roc_auc.description: Diagnostic only: threshold-free ranking quality on documents with at most 2 questions.
